description.value: Imaging substudy of a randomized, sham-controlled, double-blinded rTMS clinical trial in Veterans with treatment-resistant major depression, examining whether stimulation location relates to treatment response and whether active responder and nonresponder locations differ in resting-state functional connectivity.

spans.text: An imaging substudy of 49 Veterans (mean age, 56 years; range, 27e78 years; 39 male) from a randomized, sham-controlled, double-blinded clinical trial of rTMS treatment, grouping participants by clinical response, followed by group comparisons of treatment locations identified by individualized fiducial markers on structural MRI and resting state fMRI derived networks.

description.value: Randomized, sham-controlled, double-blinded clinical trial of active versus sham repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation, with an imaging substudy of Veterans with treatment-resistant major depression.

spans.text: Our recent multi-site, randomized, sham-controlled, double blind, rTMS study in Veterans [ 15 , 16 ] is thus particularly valuable.
